name: dev
description: Plan-driven software development with subagent delegation: explore, plan, execute, and review.

interface.shortDescription: Explore, plan, delegate, execute, and review software changes.
interface.longDescription: Dev packages four skills: the three plan-driven development skills plus a second-opinion advisor. dev-explore maps the codebase and converges on a direction, dev-write-plan turns that direction into an outcome contract under wiki/plans/, and dev-execute-plan implements the plan — delegating implementation to a host subagent by default — before verifying the result. dev-advisor (Claude Code only) consults a read-only advisor subagent pinned to the top tier, reading the repository with fresh context, before an approach hardens or work is declared done.
defaultPrompt: Use dev-explore to understand this codebase and converge on an approach.
Use dev-write-plan to turn this requirement into an implementation plan.
Use dev-execute-plan to implement a TODO plan and review the result.
